verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure and has a dedicated Docker Compose deployment guide, so a first-party Docker install path exists. A downloadable desktop app that 'runs locally' is also offered. The pack, however, never shows a single install command or any evidence of reaching a working chat in minutes, and the auth/SSO provider setup docs suggest more configuration is involved. missing for 10: the actual one-line install command (docker run/compose up, npm, or script), evidence of a minutes-to-working-chat experience, and independent or hands-on install corroboration.
